newsitem.title: GERMANY: German equity trade volumes hit year low on Monday.
newsitem.headline: German equity trade volumes hit year low on Monday.

text.p: The volume of German share trade on the Frankfurt bourse hit a year-low on Monday, when volumes amounted to 2.396 billion marks, compared to 3.88 billion marks on Friday.

Dealers said volumes were at a level normally seen between Christmas and New Year, or on days around holiday periods. They said one reason for such thin trade was the absence of dealings in London, closed for a bank holiday.
The previous year low was on August 12 when volumes were 3.49 billion marks. On December 27 and 28, 1995, volumes were 2.8 billion and 2.5 billion marks respectively.
October 2 last year, which fell between a weekend and a holiday, saw turnover of only 2.76 billion marks.
